summary: Alphabet Inc. filed an 8-K covering entry into material definitive agreements, modifications to security holder rights, and amendments to its charter. The filing references multiple series of mandatory convertible preferred stock, depositary shares, and a broad slate of senior note issuances with various maturities and interest rates. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. This is a routine capital markets disclosure. The 8-K serves to register and document the terms of these securities. There is no special situation to classify.
